command:
set -euo pipefail
BASE=/tmp/omega777-central-boot-20260912T133100Z
echo '===BOUND_SUBJECT==='
printf 'HEAD='; git -C "$BASE/current" rev-parse HEAD
for n in relay receipt_reconciler telemetry master_bridge grid; do
  echo "===LOG:$n==="
  if [ -r "$BASE/state/logs/$n.log" ]; then tail -120 "$BASE/state/logs/$n.log"; else echo MISSING; fi
done
echo '===CARRIER==='
for p in "$BASE/carrier_repo" "$BASE/state/master_bridge/LAST_ERROR.json"; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then ls -ld "$p"; [ -f "$p" ] && cat "$p"; else echo ABSENT:$p; fi; done
